verdict.rationale: Nationwide registered-agent coverage is a fair question for a registered-agent provider, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing about Northwest's state coverage: the first-party site returned a Cloudflare challenge on robots.txt, so nothing was fetched. The only community item says the company is 'good at SEO' and says nothing about which states it serves.

support.subject: As a founder, one provider covers registered-agent service in every US state, so registering in a new state does not mean finding a new vendor
